en.meta_title: Canban — Native Kanban & Terminal Workbench for AI Coding Agents
en.meta_desc: Native Rust + libghostty Kanban and terminal workbench for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), Pi, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode & 24 built-in CLIs — with Herdr persistent PTYs, Attention Inbox (⌘I), isolated Git worktree diff review, and GitHub Actions-like local workflows.
en.hero_title: Run 10+ coding agents without drowning in terminal tabs.
en.hero_description: A native Rust + libghostty Kanban and terminal workbench with an instant attention inbox (⌘I), per-card Git worktree diff review, and GitHub Actions-like local workflows.
en.ch2_title: GitHub Actions-like local workflows, zero black-box scheduling.
en.ch2_sub: Combine shell scripts with agent + prompt steps, isolated Git worktrees, cron schedules, and serialized merge queues.
en.ch3_title: Zero-wrapper native terminals that survive app restarts.
en.ch3_sub: Run Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), Pi, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and 24 built-in native CLIs in persistent Herdr PTYs — with inline Git diff review, Attention Inbox (⌘I), and remote Linux hosts over SSH/Tailscale.
